caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate wooden cabinet or clock case, rendered in shades of beige, light brown, peach, and blue. The cabinet is rectangular with a prominent curved and scalloped top, decorative blue and gray details along the upper border and in the center of the front panel. The sides are depicted with wood grain texture in warm reddish-brown tones. The front features an oval mirror or glass window in the center, bordered by painted blue and gray accents and stylized floral motifs above and below the oval. The lower part of the cabinet is wider, with a curved apron at the base, and the edges are highlighted with similar beige and light brown hues that mimic a worn, painted finish. There are additional small circular blue-gray details at the corners of the front panel, and the background of the image is plain and off-white, providing no additional context or objects. The artist's signature is present in the lower right corner.
title: Monstrance
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
